activar-recuperacion-personalizada: Activate personalized recovery management by Email (Without Database key)
activar-recuperacion-personalizada-help: Only applies if the recovery link is visible. If disabled, the native FacturaScripts modal is used (requires database password). If enabled, the user receives a link by email (requires Email configured).
agrupar-admin-general-help: Reduces the Admin menu by grouping About, Plugins, Users, and other core screens in the General folder. In horizontal menu it opens to the right (just like Auralis). Click Save and Update Menu. Does not affect Auralis or other plugins.
agrupar-admin-general-save-hint: Click Save and Update Menu to apply grouping to the top bar. In horizontal menu, General opens to the right.
agrupar-informes-menu: Group Reports screens into a submenu
agrupar-informes-menu-help: If the Reports plugin is active, its listings (Agents, Customers, Taxes…) are grouped under Reports → Reports. Other plugins in the Reports menu remain unchanged. Click Save and Refresh Menu.
agrupar-informes-menu-save-hint: Click Save and Refresh Menu to apply the Reports folder in the menu bar.
aviso-mantenimiento-desc: If filled out, it always appears in the foreground to alert the user before logging in.
aviso-mantenimiento-help: It will appear highlighted at the top. If left blank, nothing will be displayed.
botones-links-accent: Main buttons, links and active selection
calendar-default-notif-offset-help: Number of units before the event. Leave 0 or empty to not add automatic warning on new events.
calendar-default-notif-unit-help: Minutes, hours, days or weeks before the start of the event.
calendar-duracion-default-help: Minutes that are preselected when creating a new event. Value between 5 and 480 (default 60).
calendar-event-audit-deleted: Evento de calendario #%id% ('%titulo%') del autor '%nick%' fue borrado por '%deletedBy%'..
calendar-event-audit-deleted-detail: Calendar: deleted event #%id% «%titulo%» date %fecha% %hora% organizer %asignado% origin %origen% by %nick% (scope=%scope%).
calendar-event-delete-confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this event?
calendar-event-doc-save-first: Save the event before creating the sales document.
calendar-event-doc-show: Sales document button in the modal
calendar-event-doc-show-help: In My calendar, shows a button at the bottom of the event to open a new sales document with the event customer, agent and notes.
calendar-event-doc-tipo: Document to create from the event
calendar-event-doc-tipo-help: Sales document type the modal button will open (quote, order, delivery note or invoice).
calendar-event-participants-help: Internal users will see the event in their My calendar and receive alerts. Customers/contacts via email only.
calendar-event-type-duration-help: Suggested duration when choosing this type in the modal. When creating a new type it is preloaded with Calendar's default duration; you can change it later.
calendar-hora-fin: What time do you close the agenda
calendar-hora-fin-help: The grid shows from the opening hour to this one (1–24), fitted to the screen. If an event falls outside, it expands automatically, and the «24 h» button opens the whole day. Default: 21.
calendar-hora-fin-no-posterior: You set the closing time to %fin% h and the opening time to %inicio% h. Since the closing time is not later than the opening time, the agenda will show the whole day (up to 24 h).
calendar-hora-inicio-help: 24-hour grid (00:00–23:00). When you open the hourly calendar, the view scrolls to this time; you can freely move up or down. Value between 0 and 23 (default 7).
calendar-mi-show-event-status-help: If enabled, the modal and header filter of My calendar allow choosing the status (Calendar → Statuses catalog).
calendar-mi-show-event-types: Show event types in My calendar
calendar-mi-show-event-types-help: If enabled, the modal and header filter of My calendar allow choosing the type (Calendar → Types catalog).
calendar-notif-config-email-step-2: Enable the FacturaScripts Cron on your host (ideally every minute; every 5–15 min also works).
calendar-notif-config-email-step-3: Under Administrator → General → Logs (ListLogMessage), Cron tab: keep the job «auralis-send-calendar-notifications» active. Emails go out when Cron runs, not instantly. Without Cron (hosting or that job) nothing is sent.
calendar-notif-past-saved-warning: They were saved%count%reminder(s) whose sending time has already passed or the event has already started. They will not be sent by email.
calendar-notif-send-failed: Could not send reminder #%id%. Review SMTP settings.
calendar-participant-group-confirm: %count% attendees will be added (%free% more fit). Continue?
calendar-participant-group-provider-erro: Error querying the attendee group provider %provider%.
calendar-participant-group-truncated: The group has more members than the maximum number of attendees; the first ones are added.
calendar-recurrence-apply-changes: This event repeats. How do you want to apply the changes?
calendar-recurrence-delete-prompt: How do you want to remove this recurring event?
calendar-recurrence-save-prompt: How do you want to save the changes for this recurring event?
calendar-status-order-help: Position in the status pipeline (modal and calendar selectors). Lower number = appears earlier.
cashflow-alert-subtext: Review upcoming payment due dates to ensure liquidity.
clic-reordenar-elementos: Click a menu on the left to reorder its items.
clic-reordenar-paginas: Click on a submenu with pages to view and reorder its third-level items.
color-luz-afecta-bg-light: The light background is used in subtle stripes, such as list headers.
colores-bootstrap-semanticos-help: Used for buttons, alerts, and colored table rows (success, danger, warning, info, and dark). They work with any theme. Menu and brand colors are set by the theme selected above.
concentration-alert-desc: One client exceeds 35% of the total billing.
contrasena-restablecida-exito: Password reset successfully! You can now log in with your new password.
contrasenas-no-coinciden: The passwords entered do not match.
contraste-calculado-automaticamente: The contrast of the text on the menu is automatically calculated to ensure accessibility (WCAG 2.x).
custom-logo-help: It will be used as an icon in the navigation bar, side menu header and browser tab (favicon). The button allows you to select existing images or upload a new one.
dashboard-subtitle: Here is a summary of the financial health of your business.
delete-event-confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this event?
demasiados-intentos-reset: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.
desactivar-ordenacion-help: If disabled, FacturaScripts will natively sort menus alphabetically.
error-actualizar-contrasena: Could not update password. Make sure you follow security policies.
error-csrf-reset-password: The security session has expired. Reopen the link in the email or request a new one from login.
escritorio-desc: Double column design. The background image and illustration are shown on the left.
establece-nueva-clave: Set your new system access code
este-submenu-no-tiene-paginas: This item does not contain third-level pages.
evolucion-chart-tooltip: Monthly evolution of net invoiced in sales and purchases.
formato-logotipo-no-permitido: Logo format not allowed. Supported formats: PNG, SVG, JPG, ICO.
icono-logo-cabecera-help: Top left panel icon or logo.
ilustracion-central-help: Central illustration of the left area.
imagen-fondo-help: Abstract background image of the left area.
invalid-csrf-token: Invalid security token. Reload the page and try again.
jump-to-date: Click to jump to a specific date
kpi-ciclo-cobro-tooltip: Amount-weighted average of (collection date − invoice date) for sales receipts paid in the period. Excludes advance invoices. Measures cash collection cycle.
kpi-ciclo-pago-tooltip: Amount-weighted average of (payment date − invoice date) for purchase receipts paid in the period. Excludes advance invoices. Measures cash payment cycle.
kpi-ciclo-rango-ampliado: No settled collections/payments (excl. advance payments) in filter period: KPIs are shown from start of year to end date
kpi-ratio-cobrado-tooltip: Collected amount (paid receipts with collection date in period) ÷ invoiced amount (sales invoices with date in period). Excludes advance payments. May exceed 100% if receipts from previous periods are collected.
kpi-ratio-pagado-tooltip: Paid amount (paid receipts with payment date in period) ÷ purchase invoiced amount (date in period). Excludes advance payments. May exceed 100% if receipts from previous periods are paid.
kpi-retraso-cobro-tooltip: Amount-weighted average of overdue days (collection date − due date, only if positive) for collections in period. On-time or early collections count as 0 overdue days. Excludes advance payments.
kpi-retraso-pago-tooltip: Amount-weighted average of overdue days (payment date − due date, only if positive) for payments in period. On-time or early payments count as 0. Excl. advance payments.
lateral-kinetic: Action Orange, Cobalt and Snow White.
lateral-nord: Forged Steel Gray, Glacier Gray and Snow White.
lateral-pergamino: Ivory Paper, Ink Blue and Stone Gray Anti-Fatigue.
lateral-zafiro: Sapphire Blue, Slate and Snow White.
lateral-zen: Sage Green, Soft Charcoal and Sand Gray.
liquidity-tooltip:
• Real Liquidity: Balance in cash/banks accumulated from the first registration in the program until today (independent of the period).
• Forecasted future: (Collections - Payments) with maturity within the filtered period (maturity >= today).
• Pending due: (Collections - Payments) accumulated unpaid bills prior to today (due < today).
logotipo-formulario-help: It will be used above the login form.
mas-informacion-aqui: Take your company management to the next level ➔
auralis-offcanvas-cta: Take your business to the next level
mensaje-recuperacion-enviado: If the email matches a registered user, a recovery link has been sent. Check your inbox and, if you don't see it, your spam or junk folder.
menu-horizontal-hide-empresa: Hide company name in horizontal menu
menu-horizontal-hide-empresa-help: On large screens only the logo is shown, saving space for menu items. The vertical menu is unaffected.
menu-lateral-navbar: Background of the side menu and top bar
menu-order-reset-confirm: Are you sure you want to reset the menu sorting to FacturaScripts' default alphabetical order?
menu-vertical-desplazado: Vertical Menu: Content shifted to the right on PC
mi-calendario-subtitulo: Your events: created by you, assigned to you or where you are an attendee.
minimo-6-caracteres: The new password must be at least 6 characters.
mobile-breakpoint-help: Defines the maximum screen width at which the theme will activate the compact top header and fixed bottom navigation bar for mobiles/tablets (default: 992px).
mostrar-olvidado-contrasena: Show "Forgot your password?" button/link in the login form
mostrar-olvidado-contrasena-help: If unchecked, users will not see the password reset option.
movil-tablet-desc: The elements are stacked. The artwork is hidden for visual cleanliness and input fields are maximized.
net-margin-tooltip: Difference between Net Sales and Net Billing Expenses (Commercial Margin).
no-cobros-proximos-pendientes: There are no pending charges due in this period.
no-cobros-vencidos-pendientes: There are no outstanding overdue charges.
no-compras-impuestos-msg: It is not calculated when purchases/expenses are not recorded
no-compras-liquidez-msg: Requires recording purchases/expenses in the system
no-pagos-proximos-pendientes: There are no pending payments due in this period.
no-pagos-vencidos-pendientes: There are no outstanding payments due.
no-sales-period: There is no billing recorded in this period.
no-se-pudo-procesar-temp-logo: The temporary logo file could not be processed.
no-se-pudo-registrar-logotipo: The logo could not be registered in the database.
orden-menu-reset-error: Could not reset menu order. Check the logs or try again.
orden-menu-save-error: Could not save menu order. Check the logs or try again.
orden_todas_columnas: Allow sorting by all visible columns
personaliza-posicion-menus: Customize the visual position of the main menus and submenus of FacturaScripts.
placeholder-aviso-mantenimiento: Ex: Scheduled maintenance: Today at 11:00 p.m.
preview-card-desc: This box simulates the behavior of the cards, buttons and input fields in FacturaScripts with the selected values.
purchases-net-tooltip: Sum of net supplier invoices in the period. Does not include payroll, social security or amortization.
ranking-no-clientes: No settled collections in the period for customer ranking.
ranking-no-proveedores: No settled payments in the period for supplier ranking.
receipts-diff-alert-desc: There are %count% invoice(s) with difference between total and sum of receipts.
receipts-diff-alert-subtext: Check amounts or regenerate pending receipt to balance.
receipts-diff-empty: There are no invoices with discrepancy in this category.
recibos-compra-previstos-periodo: purchase receipt(s) expected in the period
recibos-venta-previstos-periodo: sales receipt(s) expected in the period
recuperar-contrasena-desc: Enter your email address linked to your account. If the account exists, we will send you a link valid for 15 minutes to reset your password.
requisito-configuracion-desc: This function allows the user to receive a secure temporary link in their email box to define a new password independently.
requisito-email-importante: IMPORTANT: To send recovery messages, it is mandatory to have previously configured the program's mail service from Administrator > Email.
resetear-contrasena: Have you forgotten your password? Reset password
sales-net-tooltip: Sum of the net of all customer invoices issued in the period.
seleccionar-subir-imagen: Select or upload image (PNG, SVG, JPG, WEBP, ICO)
sobre-pantalla-desc: This Login screen is designed under the Mobile-First concept.
solicitud-por-email: Have you forgotten your password? Email Request
tax-estimation-tooltip: Estimation based on (Output VAT - Input VAT) + Personal Income Tax Withholdings for the period. A positive amount (in red) represents an estimate to be paid, while a negative amount (in green) indicates an estimate in favor or to be returned by the tax administration.
tema-zafiro-desc: Sapphire (🔷 Deep Navy / 🏛️ Slate and Snow White)
texto-pie-pagina-help: Footer text on the login page. You can use {year}: it is replaced with the current year.
texto-presentacion-help: Main text in the illustration area (supports line breaks).
token-caducado: The recovery link has expired (maximum duration 15 minutes). Please request a new one.
token-invalido-o-usado: The recovery link is invalid or has already been used.
usuario-no-encontrado: The user associated with this request was not found.
auralis-alivio-automatizacion: Automate the entry of expenses by scanning tickets or directly synchronize your sales channels.
auralis-alivio-backups: Daily backups and secure hosting in the managed cloud.
auralis-alivio-dashboard: Dashboards and statistics in real time for safe decisions.
auralis-alivio-desarrollo: We develop custom modules: from complex technical sheets to printing specific labels.
auralis-alivio-soporte: Direct technical support, comprehensive maintenance and quick resolution of incidents.
auralis-alivio-verifactu: VeriFactu, Electronic Invoice, day registration... Keep your business 100% legal and stress-free.
auralis-avisos-alcance-familia: Sales and Purchases (Lines by product family)
auralis-avisos-desc-cliente: Appears when selecting or opening the customer in any sales document.
auralis-avisos-desc-familia: Triggers if any line in the document belongs to that family.
auralis-avisos-desc-grupo: Shows for all customers assigned to this customer group.
auralis-avisos-desc-producto: Triggers when adding the item to lines or loading a document containing it.
auralis-avisos-desc-proveedor: Appears when selecting or opening the supplier in any purchase document.
auralis-avisos-donde-cliente: Sales → Customers → Customer details → Internal notice
auralis-avisos-donde-familia: Warehouse → Product families → Family details → Internal notice
auralis-avisos-donde-grupo: Sales → Customers → Groups tab → Internal notice
auralis-avisos-donde-producto: Warehouse → Products → Product details → Internal notice
auralis-avisos-donde-proveedor: Purchases → Suppliers → Supplier details → Internal notice
auralis-avisos-info-footer: Internal notices are only visible to system users and are never printed on PDF documents or sent to customers.
auralis-avisos-info-intro: Internal notices are configured directly on each record («Internal notice» section). When creating a commercial document, if enabled above, the system displays a prominent banner with warnings:
auralis-calendar-lead-hero: Need to take your business schedule to the next level?
auralis-calendar-pain-billing-desc: Convert the appointment into a delivery note or invoice without retyping data: fewer errors and faster billing.
auralis-calendar-pain-billing-title: Billing and invoicing from the appointment
auralis-calendar-pain-booking-desc: Integrate a booking widget on your website connected in real time with FacturaScripts availability.
auralis-calendar-pain-reports-desc: Measure wait times, room occupancy, and staff productivity to optimize your resources.
auralis-calendar-pain-sync-desc: Keep your appointments and bookings always synchronized across your team's phones and tablets without duplicating work.
auralis-calendar-pain-waitlist-desc: Fill cancellations immediately: alert waiting users and maximize occupancy of rooms and professionals.
auralis-calendar-pain-whatsapp-desc: Reduce no-shows and last-minute cancellations by automatically notifying your clients.
auralis-calendario-24h-help: Show all 24 hours of the day
auralis-calendario-acceso-destino-invali: The user or group does not exist, or it is yourself.
auralis-calendario-acceso-duplicado: That access already exists in this calendar.
auralis-calendario-acceso-help: Choose a user or a group. If you leave both empty, access is for the whole company.
auralis-calendario-acceso-usuario-o-rol: Choose a user or a group, not both.
auralis-calendario-audit-borrado: Calendar %id% «%nombre%» (%tipo%) deleted along with its %eventos% events.
auralis-calendario-clave-invalida: The calendar key is not valid.
auralis-calendario-codigo-duplicado: A calendar with code %codigo% already exists.
auralis-calendario-codigo-help: Optional. Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore only.
auralis-calendario-codigo-invalido: The code only allows lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore (maximum 30).
auralis-calendario-codigo-reservado: The code %codigo% is reserved for a module calendar.
auralis-calendario-comun-empresa-descrip: Agenda events that had no organizer.
auralis-calendario-comunes-gestionan-hel: Who creates, changes and shares the company's shared calendars.
auralis-calendario-comunes-roles-help: Only if the chosen groups manage. Administrators always manage.
auralis-calendario-confirmar-borrado: Confirm deletion: all the calendar's events will also be deleted.
auralis-calendario-defecto-help: Where new events are saved if no calendar is chosen. If the user cannot edit the shared one, they are saved in their personal calendar.
auralis-calendario-empresa-help: Users from another company do not see this calendar.
auralis-calendario-empresa-marcar: Unchecked ones are not shown. Check them to see their events.
auralis-calendario-extra-desactivado: No more personal calendars can be created.
auralis-calendario-lateral: Show or hide the side panel
auralis-calendario-modulo-codigo-fijo: The code of a module calendar cannot be changed.
auralis-calendario-modulo-no-borrable: A module calendar cannot be deleted. You can deactivate it.
auralis-calendario-modulo-visibilidad: This calendar does not use access entries: it is seen by whoever has permission for the calendar page of its module (Users → Groups).
auralis-calendario-permitir-compartir-he: Each user can share their calendars with other users or groups.
auralis-calendario-permitir-extra-help: Each user can create their own calendars in addition to their main one (for example, «Family»).
auralis-calendario-personal-no-gestionab: Personal calendars are managed from My calendar.
auralis-calendario-preferencia-duplicada: You already have a preference for this calendar.
auralis-calendario-principal-duplicado: This user already has a main calendar.
auralis-calendario-principal-no-borrable: The main calendar cannot be deleted.
auralis-calendario-sin-accesos: You haven't shared it with anyone yet.
auralis-calendario-sin-permiso-edicion: You cannot add or change events in that calendar.
auralis-calendario-tipo-fijo: The type of a calendar cannot be changed.
auralis-calendario-tipo-invalido: The calendar type is not valid.
auralis-calendarios-ajustes-ayuda: Shared and module calendars are managed in the Calendars tab.
auralis-dolor-automatizacion: Do you waste hours entering data by hand?
auralis-dolor-backups: What if I lose data or the server goes down?
auralis-dolor-dashboard: Do you manage your business blindly?
auralis-dolor-desarrollo: Doesn't the program do exactly what you need?
auralis-dolor-hero: Does any of this worry you?
auralis-dolor-soporte: Who do you call if the system crashes today?
auralis-dolor-verifactu: Are you scared by new regulations and sanctions?
auralis-factura-cobrado-ayuda: Amount already paid according to this invoice's receipts.
auralis-factura-por-cobrar-ayuda: Amount still to collect according to the receipts.
auralis-gestoria-ajuste-correo: The real email limit is not set by the program: it is set by the mail server you send with (the one configured in Admin → Email) and by the recipient's server (for example, your accountant's). Gmail allows 25 MB per message and Microsoft 365, 35 MB by default. When sent, the attachment takes up about 35 % more, which is why 10 MB is a safe value.
auralis-gestoria-ajuste-email-ayuda: Suggested when sending the package; it can be changed on each send.
auralis-gestoria-ajuste-estimacion: Approximate time: with the program's standard PDF each document takes about 0.04 seconds, so 500 documents take around 20 seconds. With PlantillasPDF or on a slow server it can take much longer. If PHP's maximum execution time is exceeded, the download fails: lower this maximum or shorten the period.
auralis-gestoria-ajuste-max-mb: Maximum ZIP size to send by email (MB)
auralis-gestoria-aviso-denegados: You do not have permission to include:
auralis-gestoria-aviso-maximo: There are more documents than the maximum allowed (%maximo%). Shorten the period or filter more.
auralis-gestoria-descarga-lista: ZIP generated. The download has started.
auralis-gestoria-email-cuerpo: Hello: please find attached the sales and purchase documents for the period %desde% - %hasta% (%documentos% documents). Kind regards.
auralis-gestoria-error-envio: The email could not be sent. Check the mail settings or download the ZIP.
auralis-gestoria-error-fechas: Enter the from and to dates.
auralis-gestoria-error-generico: The operation could not be completed.
auralis-gestoria-error-maximo: There are %documentos% documents and the maximum is %maximo%. Shorten the period or filter more.
auralis-gestoria-error-permiso: You do not have permission to export documents.
auralis-gestoria-error-permiso-tipos: You do not have permission for any of the chosen document types.
auralis-gestoria-error-sin-tipos: Select at least one sales or purchase document type.
auralis-gestoria-error-tamano: The ZIP exceeds %mb% MB and cannot be sent by email. Download it and send it another way.
auralis-gestoria-error-vacio: There are no documents in the period with those filters.
auralis-gestoria-error-zip: The ZIP could not be generated.
auralis-gestoria-error-zip-extension: The server does not have the PHP ZIP extension. Ask for «zip» to be enabled in PHP.
auralis-gestoria-limites: Maximum %maximo% documents per package; sending by email up to %mb% MB.
auralis-gestoria-log-descarga: Export documents: ZIP downloaded (%desde% to %hasta%, %documentos% documents, %ficheros% files).
auralis-gestoria-log-envio: Export documents: ZIP sent by email (%desde% to %hasta%, %documentos% documents, %ficheros% files).
auralis-gestoria-log-error: Export documents: error generating the package: %error%
auralis-gestoria-modo-compras: What to include for each purchase
auralis-gestoria-subtitulo: Gathers the sales and purchase documents of a period into a ZIP, for example for your accountant, your advisor or to claim outstanding payments.
auralis-inapp-enabled-help: Shows the bell at the top: calendar reminders and news. Does not replace email or mobile push.
calendar-mi-show-rooms-help: If active, the My calendar modal allows choosing the room (Agenda → Rooms catalog).
auralis-inapp-poll-seconds-help: While the ERP is open, the bell refreshes automatically (between 60 and 90 s). Default: 75. If unsure, leave as is.
auralis-kanban-ajustes-ayuda: Each list you check will get a button to view it as a board, with one column per status, and you can change the status by dragging the cards. Statuses that create another document are shown on the board, but that step is done from the record. All of them are disabled by default.
auralis-kanban-anuncio-levantada: Card %codigo% lifted. Use the arrow keys to move it and Space to drop it
auralis-kanban-bloqueado: This document already has generated documents and cannot change status.
auralis-kanban-destino-no-valido: The target status is not valid
auralis-kanban-error-guardar: Could not change the document status
auralis-kanban-error-red: Could not connect. Please try again
auralis-kanban-genera-desde-ficha: This status creates another document. Do it from the document's record.
auralis-kanban-pista-movil: Press and hold a card to move it
auralis-kanban-sin-permiso: You do not have permission to perform this action
auralis-kanban-token-caducado: The session has expired. Reload the page
auralis-orden-natural-codigos: Natural numerical order in codes (client, document, reference...)
auralis-orden-todas-columnas: Allow sorting by all visible columns
auralis-pdf-activo: Apply this style to the PDF
auralis-pdf-activo-help: Changes the PDF generated by FacturaScripts, including the one sent by email. If you uncheck it, the PDF looks as usual.
auralis-pdf-cabecera-posicion-help: Places the company name, address and tax ID on the left or right side of the header.
auralis-pdf-cabecera-espaciado-help: Separation, from 0 to 60 points, between the company details and the document code.
auralis-pdf-logo-tamano-help: From 20 to 90 points. The original proportions are preserved and wide logos may use more horizontal space.
auralis-pdf-empresa-contacto-help: Adds the contact details available in the company record below the tax ID.
auralis-pdf-color-acento-help: For the document title, the company name and the lines.
auralis-pdf-color-cabecera-help: The header text is white or black depending on how dark the background is.
auralis-pdf-fuente-help: Theme typefaces are embedded in the PDF and make it slightly heavier (between 30 and 150 KB). Helvetica, Times and Courier add nothing.
auralis-pdf-nombre-activo-help: Applies when printing or emailing quotations, orders, delivery notes and sales and purchase invoices, from their record or from the list with the documents selected (with several, the name of the first followed by «_and_N_more»). If disabled, the file uses the FacturaScripts name.
auralis-pdf-nombre-preview-adjuntos-help: Turns attachment names in the email form into links that open in a new tab. When disabled, the form is unchanged.
auralis-pdf-nombre-preview-adjunto-title: Preview attachment in a new tab
auralis-pdf-nombre-error: The PDF name could not be generated; the FacturaScripts one is used. Detail: %error%
auralis-pdf-nombre-max-longitud-help: Between 40 and 200 characters, not counting the .pdf extension.
auralis-pdf-nombre-patron-compras-help: For example {codigo}_{proveedor}. Empty: purchases use the FacturaScripts name.
auralis-pdf-nombre-patron-ventas-help: For example {codigo}_{cliente}. Empty: sales use the FacturaScripts name.
auralis-pdf-nombre-var-cif: Tax ID of the customer or supplier.
auralis-pdf-nombre-var-fecha_ymd: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, useful for sorting files.
auralis-pdf-nombre-var-numero2: «Number 2» in sales or «Supplier no.» in purchases.
auralis-pdf-nombre-var-tercero: The customer in sales or the supplier in purchases.
auralis-pdf-nombre-var-tipo: Document type: Quote, Order, Delivery note or Invoice.
auralis-pdf-nombre-variables-consejo: For a pattern that works in both sales and purchases, use {codigo}_{tercero}. Characters that are not valid in a file name are replaced with an underscore.
auralis-pdf-nombre-variables-intro: Click a variable to add it to the pattern you are typing in, at the cursor position.
auralis-pdf-ocultar-forma-pago: Hide the payment method from the header
auralis-pdf-ocultar-forma-pago-help: This only hides it from this block; it does not remove the receipts table.
auralis-pdf-ocultar-iban-help: The payment method is still shown.
auralis-pdf-ocultar-tipo-documento-help: Hides words such as Invoice, Delivery note, Order or Estimate and leaves only the document code visible.
auralis-pdf-ocultar-recibos-help: On customer invoices the payment method is shown instead.
auralis-pdf-plantillaspdf-activo: The PlantillasPDF plugin is active and generates the PDFs, so this style is not applied.
auralis-pdf-preview-aviso: Approximate preview; the actual PDF may differ slightly.
auralis-pdf-preview-fuentes-sistema: Helvetica, Times and Courier are drawn here with similar fonts from your computer.
auralis-pdf-preview-inactivo: The style is disabled and the PDF is generated as usual. Check «Apply this style to the PDF» to make it look like this.
auralis-pdf-tamano-base-help: From 7 to 12 points (the original PDF uses 9). All other sizes are adjusted proportionally.
auralis-pdf-totales-posicion-help: Keeps totals, receipts and shipping after the items or moves that entire block together to the bottom of the page.
auralis-push-batch-limit-help: Cap of sends per Cron pass (default 50).
auralis-push-browser-service-notice: Notifications go through your browser push service.
auralis-push-card-android-1-desc: Upon entering, tap «Allow» when the browser asks if you want to receive alerts. If it does not ask and you see a crossed bell in the address bar, tap it and select Allow.
auralis-push-card-android-2-desc: Accept when prompted to «Install application». If not prompted automatically, tap the 3 dots (⋮) at the top right of the browser and select «Install application» or «Add to home screen».
auralis-push-card-ios-1-desc: Open in Safari (not Chrome, WhatsApp or email). Tap Share (square with up arrow): on iPhone it is on the bottom bar; on iPad, top right.
auralis-push-card-ios-2-desc: Choose «Add to Home Screen». Open the ERP from that new icon and tap «Allow» when asked for alerts. Without opening from the icon, iPhone will not receive push.
auralis-push-enabled-help: Alerts on the phone even when the ERP is closed. Does not replace the bell or email. Production needs HTTPS.
auralis-push-generate-vapid-help: Check and save to create new keys (required the first time).
auralis-push-generico-calendar: You have a notice in your calendar
auralis-push-howto-note: The blue bell in the menu is still the in-app channel (ERP open). Push is separate: it arrives when the ERP is closed. It does not replace the bell or email.
auralis-push-https-required: Web Push needs HTTPS in production. On HTTP only in-app and email work.
auralis-push-test-body: If you see this, ERP notifications reach this device.
auralis-push-test-error: Could not contact the server. Reload the page and try again.
auralis-push-test-failed: The test notification could not be delivered. Try again in a few minutes.
auralis-push-test-help: Sends a test notification only to your devices. Save the changes on this screen first.
auralis-push-test-no-devices: You have no registered devices. Open the ERP from your phone or browser and accept notifications.
auralis-push-test-not-ready: Mobile notifications are not ready yet: the security keys are missing. Save the settings and try again.
auralis-push-test-ok: Test notification sent. It should reach you in a few seconds.
auralis-push-max-retry-hours-help: If a notification does not reach the phone within these hours since it was created, it is no longer retried. From 1 to 168. Default: 24.
auralis-push-max-subs-help: How many phones/PCs can receive push for the same user. Over the limit, the oldest is removed.
auralis-push-sin-openssl: This server cannot generate VAPID keys (missing OpenSSL P-256 / aes-128-gcm).
auralis-push-skip-online: Skip push if in the ERP (s)
auralis-push-skip-online-help: If that user has the ERP open, no push is sent (bell only). Does not affect other users.
auralis-push-step-admin-1-desc: Check «Enable mobile alerts» above and click Save.
auralis-push-step-admin-2-desc: They are generated automatically when saving. If needed, check «Create / renew security keys…» and save again.
auralis-push-step-admin-3-desc: Without active Cron on the server, push notifications are not sent. Ideally every minute.
auralis-push-step-user-intro: Each user must authorize alerts the first time they log in from their device. It works like having an ERP app icon on the home screen.
auralis-pwa-icon-delete: Remove and revert to default icon
auralis-pwa-icon-help: Square PNG, JPEG or WebP image (512×512 recommended). No SVG. If none selected, Auralis icon is used.
auralis-pwa-icon-invalid-format: PWA icon only supports PNG, JPEG or WebP (SVG not allowed).
auralis-reset-mail-body:
You have requested to reset your access password.

Click the button below to continue. This link will expire in 15 minutes for security reasons.

If you have not requested this change, please ignore this message.
auralis-reset-sin-site-url: The password recovery email was not sent: the site URL is missing in Settings
auralis-vapid-resellar-fallido: The push private key could not be re-encrypted; the previous one is kept
auralis-arbol-vacio: There is no data to show.
auralis-arbol-error: The tree could not be loaded.
auralis-arbol-parametros-invalidos: The tree viewer parameters are not valid.
auralis-arbol-sin-permiso: You do not have permission to view this tree.
auralis-arbol-sesion-caducada: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
auralis-arbol-truncado: The tree is very large: showing the first %max% nodes.
auralis-arbol-ventana-bloqueada: The browser blocked the print window. Allow pop-ups for this site.
auralis-arbol-mas-niveles: There are more levels. Click to show them all.
auralis-calendario-acceso-audit-alta: Access to calendar %calendario% granted to %destino% with permission «%permiso%» by %gestor%.
auralis-calendario-acceso-audit-baja: Access to calendar %calendario% removed from %destino% (had «%permiso%») by %gestor%.
auralis-calendario-acceso-calendario-inv: That calendar cannot be assigned here: choose a shared or personal calendar of your companies.
auralis-calendario-audit-comun-empresa: Shared calendar «Company» (%id%) created for company %idempresa%, visible to the whole company.
auralis-calendario-compartidos-ayuda: Their own personal calendars and the people, groups or company they give access to. Read-only: the owner shares them from My calendar → ⋮ → Share. If none appears, they do not share their calendars with anyone.
auralis-calendario-compartir-avisos-help: Sharing gives access to the calendar but does not send notifications: those for each event only reach its organizer, its creator and its attendees.
auralis-calendario-compartir-desactivado: Calendar sharing is disabled. Ask an administrator to enable it in the agenda settings.
auralis-calendario-compartir-sin-avisos: Sharing a calendar does not generate notifications. Only the organizer, the creator and the attendees who have not declined are notified of an event.
auralis-calendario-heredados-ayuda: Calendars of other people or shared ones they can access without having been given direct access, only by belonging to a group or the company. Read-only: they are changed in the group or calendar record.
auralis-calendarios-compartidos: Calendars they share with other people
auralis-calendarios-por-rol: Calendars they can access through their group or company
auralis-lineas-detalle-error: Could not display the line details (%plantilla%): %error%
auralis-lineas-facturadas-bloqueadas: Lines already invoiced cannot be edited or deleted.
auralis-lineas-formulario-obsoleto: The lines form is out of date. Reload the page before saving.
auralis-lineas-hint-vacio: No lines. Click to add products or services.
auralis-lineas-limite-superado: Only %max% line(s) are allowed. Remove some before saving.
auralis-lineas-se-guardan-con-ficha: Lines are saved together with the record.
auralis-factura-pagado-ayuda: Amount already paid according to the receipts on this purchase invoice.
auralis-factura-por-pagar-ayuda: Amount still to pay according to the receipts.
